data_issues: 10 of the 30 neurons (indices 0,1,2,3,4,5,7,10,12,17) are exactly zero on every one of the 200 test trials, but they fire normally in train and val (e.g. neuron 1 averages about 15 spikes per trial, neuron 13 about 4). This looks like channels or sessions dropped or lost in the test recordings, not real silence. A decoder trained on all 30 neurons would read those zeros as real signal and fail. Fix: the decoder was trained only on the 20 neurons that are still live in test. Cross-validated accuracy drops from about 0.95 with all 30 neurons to about 0.80 with the 20 live ones. Labels match the stimulus-log category exactly, and no test trial duplicates a train or val trial.
